races.paceDynamic: Ten Pounds, Dark Cloud Rising, Fast Track Harry and Zoulu Chief will contest the early lead, with Ten Pounds likely to secure the rail position given his prominent style and recent front-running form. This creates a genuine pace scenario over 6f at Leicester, with multiple horses committed to racing prominently from the off. The sustained gallop will stretch the field and create opportunities for those with tactical speed to strike in the final furlong. This pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish with one run, as the early pace will soften up the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Ten Pounds, Dark Cloud Rising and Fast Track Harry all go forward as expected creating genuine pace pressure.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and allows the hold-up horses to pick off tired leaders in the final furlong. Annaf, Prince Of India and Kylian benefit most from this tactical setup with their proven ability to finish strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly strong and leaders tie up dramatically in the final 100 yards.
scenarios.body: Horses with the ability to sit handy and quicken late get first run on the faltering pace-setters. Fast Track Harry and Berkshire Whisper are best positioned to exploit this scenario from their mid-division berths.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ten Pounds gets an easier lead than expected with rivals reluctant to press early.
scenarios.body: The sustained but manageable gallop allows Ten Pounds to kick clear in the straight and hold on grimly. His class advantage and recent good form make him dangerous if getting his own way in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with no clear leader emerging and several horses racing keenly.
scenarios.body: The uneven gallop creates a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of early position. This chaotic scenario opens the door for any runner with residual ability to strike gold.

watchPoints.text: Ten Pounds setting uncontested lead as his class could prove decisive despite the long layoff
Fast Track Harry and Dark Cloud Rising both racing keenly early which could compromise their finishing kicks
Strike Red getting a good position early as his light weight could be significant in a strongly run race
Multiple hold-up horses including Annaf, Kylian and Prince Of India all needing the same gap in the straight
Berkshire Whisper finding cover early as he needs to conserve energy for his trademark late surge

races.paceDynamic: Dashing Dick will likely take them along from the front with Mr Lightside and Dapper Valley tracking prominently, creating a moderate gallop in the early stages. The three hold-up horses (Under The Twilight, Ormolulu, Justcallmepete, Wreck It Ryley) will need the pace to collapse or find gaps late. With only one natural leader and two other prominent runners, the pace should be sustainable rather than frantic over 6f. This race shape strongly favours the front-running and prominent horses who can dictate terms without early pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Dashing Dick gets an easy lead with Mr Lightside and Dapper Valley tracking
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too controlled for the hold-up quartet to make up ground. Dashing Dick or one of the prominent pair kick clear in the final furlong with the closers arriving too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Lightside and Dapper Valley press Dashing Dick from early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo suits the prominent runners who can quicken off a stronger pace. The battle between the front three sets it up perfectly for whichever prominent runner has most left.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong between the front three
scenarios.body: The tempo collapse allows the back markers to close dramatically in the final 2f. Under The Twilight or Justcallmepete benefit most from the stronger early gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Dashing Dick Wire-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Dashing Dick gets completely uncontested early fractions
scenarios.body: He builds an unassailable lead that the field cannot peg back despite their late efforts. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save enough for a final kick.

watchPoints.text: Dashing Dick could steal this if the pace becomes too pedestrian and nobody challenges his lead early
The hold-up quartet all need similar race conditions which creates traffic problems if gaps don't appear
Mr Lightside's prominent style could be the perfect compromise between the front-runner and hold-up horses
Ormolulu and Dashing Dick both return from long breaks which adds fitness questions to their chances
Justcallmepete's recent winning form makes him the most likely closer if the pace does set up right

races.paceDynamic: Cameley Days is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the rail, setting a controlled gallop without pressure. The prominent runners Starsong, Shark Two One, and Mickey Mongoose will track within striking distance, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Von Krolock, Instant Bond, Call Glory, Dark Sun, and Dragon God will be positioned towards the rear. With minimal pace pressure early and a substantial hold-up contingent, this sets up as a tactical affair that will develop into a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can secure good positions without expending energy, as they'll have the tactical advantage when the race develops in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Cameley Days sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical sprint where positioning trumps pure finishing speed. Prominent runners like Starsong and Shark Two One exploit their superior tactical position over the cramped hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Find Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent can secure clear runs in the straight despite the bunched finish
scenarios.body: Von Krolock and Instant Bond capitalize on their recent good form with well-timed challenges. The sheer weight of numbers from deep favours one breaking through despite positional disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Exploits Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Cameley Days maintains his advantage while the field gets into a scrimmage behind
scenarios.body: The lone leader benefits from the tactical positioning battle developing behind him. Despite his tendency to fade, the lack of early pace pressure allows him to last longer than usual.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Cameley Days sets crawling fractions and the race becomes a pure sprint from the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race turns into a dash where pure speed dominates over positioning. Just King High's high TopSpeed rating becomes crucial in a blanket finish where anything can happen.

watchPoints.text: Watch Cameley Days early - if he goes too fast trying to exploit his lone lead, he'll set this up perfectly for closers
Monitor the hold-up horses Instant Bond and Von Krolock for clear runs - both have winning recent form but need luck
Check if Shark Two One handles the return from 199-day absence, as prominent runners rarely need much fitness
Observe Just King High's positioning - his sprint speed could be decisive if he gets into contention despite low rating
Watch for scrimmaging among the large hold-up contingent in the straight, as traffic problems will determine placings

races.paceDynamic: Porter's Song will set the early tempo with minimal pressure from limited pace angles like Miss Chester, Evelyn's Phoenix, and Shabu Shabu. The modest early gallop will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses to stay in touch before unleashing their finishing kicks. With only one genuine front-runner and multiple proven late runners like Happy Chandler, Silkies Sib, and He's Our Cracker, this race sets up perfectly for closers. The tactical advantage lies decisively with hold-up horses who can capitalise on the honest but undemanding early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Porter's Song sets steady fractions without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The large field of hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Late runners with proven stamina at this trip will have too much firepower for the limited pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Chester or Evelyn's Phoenix can dictate terms from an advanced position
scenarios.body: A horse racing closer to the pace avoids the traffic problems that could hinder the hold-up brigade. The winner comes from those who can press the tempo then find extra when challenged.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Porter's Song gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to conserve energy and prove hard to peg back. Porter's Song capitalises on the field's tactical naivety in allowing such soft sectionals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Handy
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates a messy finish with interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get shuffled back in a rough race while those racing handily avoid the worst of the trouble. Horses positioned prominently throughout prove best placed to capitalise.

watchPoints.text: Porter's Song could steal this if allowed completely uncontested fractions given the field's tactical setup
Miss Chester and Shifra both show concerning patterns of fading in the finish at longer distances
Happy Chandler carries just 124lbs and showed excellent finishing kick when winning last time
Multiple horses returning from extended breaks including Beauty Generation, Celtic Spirit, and Shifra
The good to firm ground conditions favour proven performers Happy Chandler and Evelyn's Phoenix who have winning form on similar surfaces

races.paceDynamic: Great Success will take them along from the front with Venetian Romance, Chelio, Eduardo Calderon, Yachtsman and Sprinting Speed all sitting prominent early, creating a competitive pace battle through the first half of this 7f contest. The abundance of prominent racers means the pace will be solid but not suicidal, with multiple horses happy to race handy. This sets up perfectly for the strong hold-up contingent led by Lion Of Mali, Pretty Danielle, Horwich and Daretobedifferent to come with late runs. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the pace battle ahead of them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent brigade go too hard early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The pace collapse allows the patient runners to sweep past with Lion Of Mali and Pretty Danielle perfectly positioned to strike. Horwich and Daretobedifferent also benefit from their patient tactics as the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the forward runners gets the fractions right and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Venetian Romance or Yachtsman could time their move perfectly to get first run on the field while the hold-up horses are still making ground. The winner comes from those who raced handy but avoided the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Toughs Out
scenarios.trigger: If Great Success gets uncontested lead and the pace becomes too slow
scenarios.body: Great Success could dictate terms from the front and have enough left to repel late challenges on ground that suits. The lack of early pressure allows the leader to control the race and stay on strongly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go steadier than expected and bunch the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. Sprinting Speed or Pretty Danielle could benefit from a truly run race that becomes tactical.

watchPoints.text: Great Success could get uncontested lead if prominent horses don't press early enough
Eduardo Calderon faces fitness test after 184 days off despite having ability when fresh
Lion Of Mali has won three of last four starts and gets perfect race setup
Pretty Danielle has strong course record with three places from seven visits
Venetian Romance carries 7lb claimer but apprentice may struggle in finish
